904:                     special = true;

911:                 | '*' | '?' | '[' | '#' | '˜' | '=' | '%' => {

927:     /// Escapes special characters in a string, so that it will retain its literal
928:     /// meaning when used as a part of command in Unix shell.

932:     pub fn quote(s: &str) -> std::borrow::Cow<str> {
933:         // We are going somewhat out of the way to provide
934:         // minimal amount of quoting in typical cases.
935:         match escape_style(s) {
936:             EscapeStyle::None => s.into(),
937:             EscapeStyle::SingleQuoted => format!("'{}'", s).into(),
938:             EscapeStyle::Mixed => {
939:                 let mut quoted = String::new();
940:                 quoted.push('\'');
941:                 for c in s.chars() {

pub fn signal_by_name_or_value(signal_name_or_value: &str) -> Option<usize> {
    if let Ok(value) = signal_name_or_value.parse() {
        if is_signal(value) {

        } else {
            return None;
        }
    }
    let signal_name = signal_name_or_value.trim_start_matches("SIG");

    ALL_SIGNALS.iter().position(|&s| s == signal_name)
}

pub fn is_signal(num: usize) -> bool {
